critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1270 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Splitting into routers/{characters,renders,shoots,kink_presets,workflows,ai}.py is due. Not blocking.

buildPrompts in dna.js is ~300 lines and does 9 sequential joins — consider extracting per-section builders (buildSubject, buildOutfit, buildExplicit, etc.) for testability and reuse with buildPonyPrompts.
KinkPresetsMenu.saveCurrent() uses window.prompt() which is blocked in some embedded contexts and is not styled — replace with a small controlled inline input to match app aesthetic.
The delete-preset confirm uses window.confirm() — same UX inconsistency; consider a shadcn AlertDialog.

PATCH /api/characters/{cid} uses `if v is not None` filter which means clients CANNOT explicitly set raunch/favorite back to false via a null-tolerant patch — currently works because Pydantic exclude_unset keeps them out unless set. Confirmed round-trip works. Nit only.
server.py update_settings allowed-set does NOT include 'default_workflow_id' consistently — wait, it does. False alarm.
KINK_PRESETS Bukkake Queen sets scenario.cast_size='group' but doesn't touch scenario.cast_type — minor DNA consistency polish.

No backend validation that scenario.explicit_level / kink_level are 0-100 integers — client-side only. Adding a Pydantic model for DNA sub-schemas would harden against garbage input from API consumers.
